verdict.rationale: The only evidence of targeted, region-preserving edits is mask-based local re-editing, and it is documented for Image 3.0 Omni (still images), not for existing videos. The video-related items are either vague ('refine and edit your videos through multiple rounds of post-production') or a pricing line for 'video input' that does not describe element replacement or restyling while keeping the rest of the frame intact. These are adjacent capabilities, not this story's capability.

support.subject: As a creator, I can replace or restyle an element inside an existing video while the rest of the frame stays intact
